40010828.author: पदार्थः
40010828.content: कपिराजेन by the king of monkeys, व्यादिष्टाः commanded, कपियूधपाः leaders of vanara troops, यथोक्तम् as instructed, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, दर्शनार्थम् to look for, अञ्जसा swiftly, सर्वतः all directions, जग्मुः went.

40010828.author: Translation
40010828.content: The leaders of vanara troops went fast in all directions to look for Vaidehi following the instructions of  the king of vanaras.

40010829.author: पदार्थः
40010829.content: ते they, सरांसि tanks, सरित: कक्षान् bottom of rivers, आकाशम् sky, नगराणि च and towns, तथा similarly, नदीदुर्गान् forts surrounded by rivers, शैलान् mountains, समन्ततः every where, विचिन्वन्ति looking for.

40010829.author: Translation
40010829.content: They went looking everywhere in the tanks, in the bottom of rivers, in towns, in the sky and similarly in inaccessible rivers, mountains, and forts surrounded by rivers.

40010830.author: पदार्थः
40010830.content: सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, समाख्याताः instructed, सर्वे all, वानरयूथपाः vanara troop leaders, सशैलवनकाननान् including forests and mountains, प्रदेशान्  places, विचिन्वन्ति searched.

40010830.author: Translation
40010830.content: The troop leaders of the monkeys instructed by Sugriva searched in all places including mountains and forests.

40010831.author: पदार्थः
40010831.content: सर्वे all, वानराः monkeys, सीताधिगमने in search of Sita, धृताः determined, दिवसम् all day, विचित्य after searching, निशाकालेषु during nights also, मेदिन्याम् on the ground, समायान्ति स्म used to meet one another.

40010831.author: Translation
40010831.content: The monkeys used to search for Sita all day determinedly and at night assemble at one place.

40010832.author: पदार्थः
40010832.content: ते वानराः those monkeys, सर्वेषु अहस्सु all day, सर्वर्तुकामान् in all seasons, सफलद्रुमान् fruitbearing trees, देशेषु in countries, आसाद्य having reached, रजनीम् in the night, शय्याम् resting place, चक्रुः they made.

40010832.author: Translation
40010832.content: The monkeys would search all day and by night reach for rest the branches of the trees that bear fruits in all seasons.

40010833.author: पदार्थः
40010833.content: तत् अहः that day, प्रथमम् first, कृत्वा having passed off, मासे in the month, कपियूधपाः monkey leaders, निराशाः disappointed, प्रस्रवणम् mountain Prasravana, गताः gone, कपिराजेन by the king of vanaras, सङ्गम्य after meeting.

40010833.author: Translation
40010833.content: The monkey leaders thus spent a month doing what they did daily and returning disappointed, met the monkey king on mount Prasravana.

40010834.author: पदार्थः
40010834.content: महाबलः powerful, विनतः Vinata, सचिवैः सह along with the ministers, यथोक्ताम् as instructed, पूर्वां दिशम् eastern side, विचित्य having searched, सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा not able to see, आजगाम returned.

40010834.author: Translation
40010834.content: Having searched for Sita as instructed by  Sugriva, powerful Vinita returned along with the ministers unable to find Sita.

40010835.author: पदार्थः
40010835.content: तदा then, वीरः hero, महाकपिः great monkey, शतबलः Satabala, सैन्येन सह with the army, सर्वाम् all, उत्तरां दिशम् northern direction, विचित्य after searching, आगतः came back.

40010835.author: Translation
40010835.content: Then the great monkey hero Satabali came back from the northern direction along with the army after searching in vain for Sita.

40010836.author: पदार्थः
40010836.content: सुषेणः Sushena, वानरैस्सह along with the monkeys, पश्चिमाम् आशाम् western side, विचित्य having searched, मासे in a month, सम्पूर्णे when completed, समेत्य after coming back, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, उपचक्रमे reported.

40010836.author: Translation
40010836.content: Sushena searched for a full month in the western quarter along with the monkeys and returned to report to Sugriva.

40010837.author: पदार्थः
40010837.content: रामेण सह along with Rama, आसीनम् seated, प्रस्रवणपृष्ठस्थम् on the Prasravana mountain, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, आसाद्य came near, अभिवाद्य च and offered salutations, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40010837.author: Translation
40010837.content: Sushena came to Sugriva, seated with Rama at Prasravana mountain, offered salutations and spoke:

40010838.author: पदार्थः
40010838.content: सर्वे all, पर्वताः mountains, विचिताः are searched, गहनानि inacccessible, वनानि च forests also, निम्नगाः rivers, सागरान्ताश्च in the seas, ये those, जनपदाश्च country side, सर्वे every where.

40010838.author: Translation
40010838.content: 'We searched for her in the mountains, in inaccessible forests, in rivers and seas and also the countryside.

40010839.author: पदार्थः
40010839.content: सर्वाः all, त्वया by your, परिकीर्तिताः mentioned, याः those, गुहाः caves, विचिताः searched, लताविततसन्तताः filled with extensive vines, महागुल्माः and huge bushes, विचिताः are searched.

40010839.author: Translation
40010839.content: 'We searched for her in the caves, in places filled with extensive vines and huge bushes and in all places mentioned by you.

40010840.author: पदार्थः
40010840.content: गहनेषु in the interiors, दुर्गेषु inaccessible, विषमेषु च and unevenplaces, देशेषु locations, अतिप्रमाणानि very huge, सत्त्वानि beings, विचितानि searched, हतानि च killed, गहनाः difficult interiors, ये those, देशाः places, ते those, पुनः पुनः again and again, विचिताः searched.

40010840.author: Translation
40010840.content: 'We searched again and again the interior, inaccessible and uneven locations,and killed huge animals. We searched in regions difficult to penetrate.

40010841.author: पदार्थः
40010841.content: वानरेन्द्र O king of monkeys, उदारसत्त्वाभिजनः exhalted by strength and birth, सः that, महात्मा  great person, मैथिलीम् Maithili, द्रक्ष्यति will see, सीता sita, याम् एव whichever, दिशम्  direction, गता is taken, ताम् that, वायुसुतः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, आस्थितः he has set out.

40010841.author: Translation
40010841.content: 'O king of monkeys we hope, his exhalted highness, the mighty vanara, son of the Windgod, Hanuman has gone in the direction in which Maithili has been carried off. He alone will find Sita and come back.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
